lines.t: Yeah…
Sweet days, bitter nights—
Let it all pour.
Take your fill.
Watch what it turns into.
Sip, sip—take your fill,
Sweet with the bitter, let it spill.
Some things take a little time,
What I couldn’t see comes into light.
When understanding comes, comes,
Like the morning sun, sun,
What I called bitter got sweet to me.
(Sweet, sweet—got sweet to me!)
First taste sweet, had me back for seconds,
What I called bitter got sweet to me.

One door closed, made the whole thing stop.
Thought that no meant the end of the road,
Only saw the weight, not the room to grow.
